questions.question_english: 26. Which political organization/party did NOT participate in the First Round Table Conference held in London (1930–31)?

questions.question_english: 67. The States Reorganization Commission (SRC) appointed in December 1953, which assessed the demand for states based on linguistic lines, was chaired by whom?
questions.explanation_english: The States Reorganization Commission (SRC) was established by Prime Minister Jawaharlal Nehru in December 1953 to evaluate state boundaries based on linguistic lines. The commission was chaired by retired Supreme Court Justice Fazl Ali, with members H.N. Kunzru and K.M. Panikkar. The Fazl Ali Commission submitted its report in September 1955, which broadly accepted language as the primary criterion for reorganizing state boundaries.
questions.explanation_hindi: सही उत्तर (c) है। राज्यों के पुनर्गठन आयोग (SRC) की स्थापना प्रधानमंत्री जवाहरलाल नेहरू द्वारा दिसंबर 1953 में की गई थी, जिसका उद्देश्य भाषाई आधार पर राज्य सीमाओं का मूल्यांकन करना था। इस आयोग की अध्यक्षता सेवानिवृत्त सुप्रीम कोर्ट के न्यायमूर्ति फ़ज़ल अली ने की, जिसमें एच.एन. कुंज़रु और के.एम. पानिक्कर सदस्य थे। फ़ज़ल अली आयोग ने सितंबर 1955 में अपनी रिपोर्ट प्रस्तुत की, जिसमें भाषाई आधार पर राज्य सीमाओं के पुनर्गठन को प्राथमिकता दी गई।
key_facts: Printed answer key: (C) Justice Fazl Ali

18. Consider the following statements regarding the Non-Cooperation Movement (1920–22):
A. It included the surrender of titles and honours awarded by the British government.
B. Boycott of government schools, colleges, and law courts was an integral part of the program.
C. Mahatma Gandhi continued the movement without interruption even after the Chauri Chaura incident.

questions.explanation_english: The Non-Cooperation Movement program involved surrendering government titles, boycotting colonial educational institutions, courts, and foreign cloth, while promoting Swadeshi goods and national schools. key_facts: Printed answer key: (A) A and B only
Answer explanation extracted from supplied reference material: The Non-Cooperation Movement program involved surrendering government titles.

30. Match List I with List II.
List I: (Constitutional Act)
P. Government of India Act, 1909
Q. Government of India Act, 1919
R. Government of India Act, 1935

List II: (Key Feature)

questions.explanation_english: The Government of India Act 1909 introduced separate communal electorates for Muslims. The Government of India Act 1919 established Dyarchy in provincial governance.
